study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter observational study
outcome: Preterm labor requiring hospitalization or tocolysis
cohort: Women with prior CD and either PAS (n=194) or placenta previa alone (n=687)
finding: Women with PAS who have had ≥2 prior CD did not appear to have a higher risk of complications leading to delivery prior to 34 weeks compared to women with <2 prior CD.
